_readme: Server-cost model used to estimate the tick cost of ONE walker. All coefficients are PLACEHOLDERS until calibrated: profile a walker in the sandbox with spark (/spark profiler --timeout 60), divide the walker-related self-time by ticks, and adjust the numbers below until `npm run check` matches. Units: microseconds of server thread per tick.

renderOnly._about: Legs are pure client-side render; server only tracks foot targets and syncs joint angles.

contraption._about: Each leg is a Create-style contraption entity (collidable, moves its blocks).

subLevel._about: Each leg segment is its own Sable sub-level with physics/collision. Most faithful, most expensive.
